note: Planted in fixtures/acme on purpose. Used to measure how many real problems the personas and analyst recover (plan section 9.4). This is a calibration target, not a real-world validity claim.

issues.title: Team members are only reachable from the avatar menu, under 'Organization'
issues.detail: Not in the main nav and not linked from Settings, where most people look first.

issues.title: Notification toggles show on/off only by red vs green fill
issues.detail: The knob never moves and there is no text, so red-green color blind users cannot tell the state.

issues.title: A missing role on the invite form is shown only as a red border
issues.detail: No message says what is wrong; the form just does not submit.

issues.title: The 'edit' link for the display name is tiny and very light grey
Invite confirmation is a toast that disappears after 1.5 seconds
issues.detail: Easy to miss; nothing else confirms the invite except the table row.

issues.title: The avatar menu is a div with a click handler: not focusable, no role
issues.detail: Keyboard and screen reader users cannot reach Profile or Organization at all.
